newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - FTSE 100 cautiously eyes all-time high.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - FTSE 100 cautiously eyes all-time high.

text.p: The UK's FTSE 100 index could challenge its all-time closing high of 4,444.3 in the short-term, chart analysts said on Wednesday, but warned the forthcoming election could temper any significant advance.
They said the blue chip index was well supported at 4,250 and the next major resistance level was around the all-time high.
"It all depends how we close tonight," said Paul White of Trend Analysis. "If we hold above the 4,370 level then the all-time high could be the next target."
White said that the election and the prospect of a near-term interest rate rise could prevent any significant upside from that level.
The FTSE 100 stood at 4,378.5, up 32.4 points at 0850 GMT.
